messages:
Priya Rao: Hey team — onboarding PoppyTech. They're running a UX pilot in AU/NZ and are getting 403s; customer says their infra is blocking our egress NAT. They asked for an allowlist on our edge for their proxy IPs plus a short QPS increase so they can validate flows. Renewal and expansion depend on this pilot going smoothly. :worried:
Diego Martinez: Got it. Do we have the exact IP ranges and the QPS target they want?
Priya Rao: Yup. They gave these: 203.52.128.0/22, 43.224.0.0/18, and a static NAT 52.65.32.10. They asked that we scope it to ap-southeast-2 only. QPS request is 150 -> 800 for 72 hours.
Diego Martinez: Low risk to add customer IPs to inbound allowlist. Rate bump needs a policy, window, and auto-revoke. Suggest: temp-rate-lift 800 qps, window 72h, auto-revoke. Pin to ap-southeast-2.
Elliot Chung: Capacity check: we have spare headroom in ap-southeast-2 to absorb +650 qps for 72h, but isolate to a single model shard to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. Recommend model:gptx-8k only and a circuit-breaker that trips if p95 > 1s.
Samira Patel: Billing note: they're on trial credits but open to convert if pilot is good. Flag finance for potential overage invoice beyond credits. Also capture feedback for renewal conversation.
Priya Rao: I'll add an enablement checklist and ask solutions to run smoke tests after the allowlist is applied.
Diego Martinez: Applying inbound allowlist and temporary rate policy now. Commands: 
```
rbw ops apply-allowlist --customer poppytech --direction inbound --ips "203.52.128.0/22,43.224.0.0/18,52.65.32.10" --region ap-southeast-2 --expires "2024-07-01T12:00:00Z"
rbw ops set-rate-policy --customer poppytech --region ap-southeast-2 --model gptx-8k --qps 800 --window 72h --auto-revoke true
```
Priya Rao: :crossed_fingers: Tag me when done so I can notify customer and kick off tests.
ops-bot: Command received: apply-allowlist (request-id 0a3f9c). Initiating change.
ops-bot: set-rate-policy queued (policy-id rp-9921).
ops-bot: allowlist applied — rule id al-7742 — scope: inbound, region ap-southeast-2, expires 2024-07-01T12:00:00Z.
ops-bot: rate policy active — policy id rp-9921 — qps 800 — window 72h — auto-revoke true.
Diego Martinez: Done. Who's running the smoke test?
Priya Rao: I will run on our side and ping PoppyTech to run theirs.
Priya Rao: Smoke test results: 5/5 requests success, no 403s, latencies within expected range.
Samira Patel: Great. I'll open a renewal playbook note: pilot trending positive; recommend account exec reach out 72 hours before revoke to discuss committed capacity pricing and discounts. Feedback captured: they want clearer docs about region-specific egress and a simpler allowlist workflow in the console.
Elliot Chung: Adding a monitoring rule: alert if error rate > 1% or p95 latency > 1s during the window so we can rollback proactively.
Priya Rao: Thanks all — I'll update the support ticket and schedule a day-2 check-in with the customer. :calendar:
Diego Martinez: Added follow-up on my calendar. Closing thread after auto-revoke verification.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: revoke-check at 2024-07-01T12:05:00Z (check policy rp-9921).
